decisions.reason: The source changes R16/R17/R18 for the three panel inputs only; it does not change the separate BOOT button or J_RESET circuit.
The source pull-ups are GPIO input-bias resistors for panel controls, not the I2C SDA/SCL pull-ups or series resistors.
Changing panel-input biasing does not alter the ESP32 module selection, pin breakout, breakout pitch, or full-pin-access requirement.
The source changes electrical polarity and resistor biasing but does not reassign any GPIO or change the GPIO compatibility policy.
The panel-input pull-ups are unrelated to the e-paper backlight's GPIO42 PWM control, gate resistor, gate pull-down, and supply selection.
Using the existing 3.3V rail for panel-input pull-ups does not change the configured DCDC1 voltage or its regulation requirement.
The source does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
The panel-input bias change does not alter the standalone regulator, its capacity, source-selection topology, or powered load.
The source concerns panel button and switch inputs, not addressable-LED power cutoff, control GPIO, or MOSFET topology.
The source explicitly leaves PIR and touch sensor pull-downs unchanged and does not alter sensor logic voltage compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The panel-control pull-up decision does not change addressable-LED supply voltage, data drive, or level-shifter requirements.
The statement that panel-control connector pin 1 remains GND applies to the panel connectors, not the modular interboard connector pinouts or board topology.
